claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak

risks.risk: Cylinder capacity may not be 20kg (price depends heavily on size).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity (e.g., 20kg) and serial/markings, plus a photo of the full cylinder label if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case size you can’t confirm from photos (treat as not-confirmed capacity), using the lowest comparable that matches a generic cylinder listing rather than a confirmed 20kg.

risks.risk: Leak/test status not verifiable remotely; cylinder could fail pressure/leak test.
risks.proof: A recent test/certification sticker photo (readable) and/or a short video showing a proper leak test result (soap-bubble check) at the valve/regulator connection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven (assume it may need re-testing), i.e., at the lower end of cylinder comparables.

risks.risk: Valve/regulator condition may be worn or mismatched even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the valve/regulator threads and connection points, plus a video of the valve opening/closing smoothly (no sticking) and a tight connection check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as valve condition unknown (worst case: treat as needing replacement/servicing).

risks.risk: Rust/age may indicate higher wear and shorter remaining service life.
risks.proof: Photos of the cylinder base/foot ring and any dents, plus a close-up of the rust level around the valve collar.
risks.if_unproven: Price as fairly used with visible wear (worst case within what’s visible).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo showing the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity (confirm 20kg) and any serial/markings.
Photo of the certification/test sticker with readable date (or a document) and/or a short clip of a leak test at the valve/regulator connection.
Close-up photos of the valve/regulator (threads, connection points) and a short video showing the valve opens/closes properly.
Photos of the cylinder base/foot ring and any dents/major corrosion areas.
response.reason: The photo does not clearly confirm the cylinder capacity (20kg) or provide readable certification/test evidence; without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
